source_quote:
The `cache_config` parameter is typed as `CacheConfig | None = None`, but its attribute `block_size` is accessed directly via `cache_config.block_size` without any safety checks. If `cache_config` is `None`, this will raise an `AttributeError` at runtime. Adding an assertion ensures that `cache_config` is properly provided before it is accessed.
The `cache_config` parameter is typed as `CacheConfig | None` but is required to initialize `AscendDeepseekV4IndexerCache` and `Compressor`. If `cache_config` is `None`, it will cause an `AttributeError` later when accessing its attributes. Adding an assertion ensures defensive programming and catches configuration errors early.

rule.description: 当函数形参声明为 `cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None`（允许 `None`），但函数体内直接 `cache_config.xxx` 访问属性（即隐式假设非 `None`）时，必须在类型层面将该参数改为必填的 `CacheConfig`（或 `CacheConfig` + `*` 强制关键字），并通过 mypy 在所有调用点强制检查；不要用 `# type: ignore[union-attr]` 或运行期 `assert` 来掩盖设计缺陷。
checkpoints: 检查形参为 `XxxConfig | None = None` 的参数在函数体内是否被直接访问属性
如果有 `# type: ignore[union-attr]` 注释，说明类型设计与实际使用不一致
优先将类型改为非 Optional（让 mypy 在调用点强制校验），而不是仅加 `assert`（运行期才暴露）
修改后调用点若传 `None` 会被 mypy 拒绝，迫使所有调用方修复
对称结构（如 `Compressor` 与 `Indexer` 同时使用 `cache_config`）要同步修改

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/compressor.py (Compressor.__init__)
def __init__(
    self,
    compress_ratio: int = 4,
    head_dim: int = 512,
    rotate: bool = False,
    cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,   # ❌ 类型允许 None
    quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
    prefix: str = "",
):
    ...
    if compress_ratio == 4:
        self.state_cache = AscendCompressorStateCache(
            ...
            block_size=DSV4_BLOCK_SIZES[cache_config.block_size][0][2],  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            # ❌ 直接 .block_size 访问，None 时 AttributeError；只能靠 type: ignore 掩盖
        )

        self.state_cache = AscendCompressorStateCache(
            ...
            block_size=DSV4_BLOCK_SIZES[cache_config.block_size][0][2],   # ✅ 移除 type: ignore
        )
